column1: # Kristall's spelling in capitals -> ours, for kristall_write.py: a name or word Kristall writes in
# capitals (PROF. LIND, KNOFENSA-TURM, #MON, des NACHTs). Words only, never sentences.
# A word Kristall splits at a line end ("ARENA-" / "LEITER") is listed joined, as German writes it
# (ARENALEITER -> Arenaleiter) or with its hyphen (KNOFENSA-TURM -> Knofensa-Turm).
# Columns: Kristall, ours, and optionally a text's label: that row answers for that text only
